title: FoodData Central
journal: Ag Data Commons, U.S. Department of Agriculture
funder: U.S. Department of Agriculture. The FoodData Central site, under the Agricultural Research Service, describes FoodData Central as USDA's comprehensive source of food composition data; SR Legacy values derive from analyses, imputations and the published literature, Foundation Foods values from analysed samples with metadata, and only the Branded Foods data type, not used here, comes from a public-private partnership with food industry data providers.
result: Oil, olive, salad or cooking (SR Legacy, FDC 171413), per 100 g: energy 884 kcal (3700 kJ); total lipid 100 g; saturated fatty acids 13.8 g (16:0 11.3 g, 18:0 1.95 g); monounsaturated 73.0 g (18:1 71.3 g, 16:1 1.26 g); polyunsaturated 10.5 g (18:2 9.76 g, 18:3 0.761 g); alpha-tocopherol 14.4 mg; phylloquinone 60.2 µg; phytosterols 221 mg; 1 tablespoon 13.5 g. Oil, olive, extra virgin (Foundation Foods, FDC 748608, https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/portal-data/external/748608; 36 samples bought in California, Maryland, Virginia and New York from June to August 2019), per 100 g: monounsaturated 69.2 g, of which 18:1 cis 67.8 g (range 56.9 to 73.2); saturated 15.4 g; polyunsaturated 9.07 g (18:2 n-6 8.4 g, 18:3 n-3 0.651 g); beta-sitosterol 126 mg.
